Title: Support for more workloads, tag based policies now in Backup Center public preview

Body.Content:
Backup Center public preview now includes support for 3 additional workloads - SQL in Azure VM, SAP HANA in Azure VM and Azure Files.  With this, you can now centrally manage and monitor backups of all Azure-based workloads (that are supported by Azure Backup) across your entire backup estate. 

This update of Backup Center also includes new built-in policies for Azure Backup that allow you to configure backup of Azure Virtual Machines at scale based on resource group and tag information. 

For more details, refer the documentation below:  

Supported workloads in Backup Center.

New built-in Azure policies for configuring VM Backup.

Overview of Backup Center.
